title: SigningKey::preferred_digest_algorithm / DecryptionKey::supported_key_enc_algorithm never consulted
description: Both trait methods are documented as 'extension points for callers', but the crate never calls them. A library that exports a trait method as a hint but ignores the hint is a footgun: implementors will override preferred_digest_algorithm() expecting sign() to respect it, but sign() hardcodes SHA-256. Either consult the hint internally or remove the method and let callers handle selection before calling sign().
